name: Shiokaze no Memory
source:
This is a pure love AVG, which is about a guy and six girls in a drama club. 

Masahiko Mikage, advisor to the drama club, and six girls set out to an inn for a 3-day summer training exercise. 

Masahiko's never been to the place, but he feels as if he's been here before. He also gets extremely interested in the folklore behind the "Divorce Rock..." 

How is he related to this place...!? Aren't you curious...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050308114806/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2002/s/shiokaze_no_memory_dvdpg/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
这是一部纯爱AVG，讲述戏剧社的一名男子和六名女孩的故事。

戏剧社顾问御影正彦和六名女孩前往一家旅馆，进行为期三天的暑期集训。

正彦从未去过那里，却感觉自己似乎曾经来过。他还对“离婚岩”背后的民俗传说产生了浓厚兴趣……

他与这个地方有什么关系……！？你不好奇吗……？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050308114806/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2002/s/shiokaze_no_memory_dvdpg/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
